name: Neubauer's Ray-Voxel Intersection Algorithm
definition: An algorithm for finding the intersection of a ray with an iso-surface within a voxel, using repeated linear interpolation to refine the root location after identifying the correct segment via polynomial root analysis.
summary: Neubauer's algorithm finds ray-voxel intersections using repeated linear interpolation, balancing speed and accuracy while avoiding the complexity of closed-form algebraic solutions.
